Both final structural closeups opened: real setback walls/backplates at service and observation recesses; seated roof tray, five fixed louvers, fitted rails/anchors; no caption shadows.

All four final cue states opened: source citadel amber and gauntlet orange hues at BREATHE1.0/.1. Cue is a narrow static strip, with no barrel, weapon core or red strobe geometry. Offline emission is not source-shader color equivalence.
All six common WORLD 1:1 panels opened: identical ship/bunker placement across Classic/Modern/Chase; unscaled shipped player remains visually primary; no object-fitted world cameras.

Final full-resolution citadel/classic frame opened individually. Bunker remains on the far shoulder beside the lane x16 marker; player is separate, at original shipped dimensions. limitations: Offline native Linux software EEVEE; source-lighting, mapped-hull-average and deck test doubles, no live GPU/FPS evidence.
Specular sampling noise remains in some 24-sample studio highlights; no source texture-normal-map or bloom equivalence.
At Classic world scale the small bunker silhouette/status cue survives but fine seams/louvers are not individually legible; dark world body is intentionally subordinate to the player.
Pixel-space captions are outside original renders and proven not to crop/recolor original pixels or cast shadows.
Live renderer integration, gameplay/camera occlusion acceptance, receiver verification and deferred Opus polish belong to orchestrator.
